Output: Gender inclusive local employment generated Indicator: Number of additional jobs provided by the borrowers and contractors during construction of the project amount to at least 180, of which 18 are for women, by 2021 (October 2020 baseline: 128, number of women: 13) Data Source: Annual development effectiveness monitoring reports by the borrower Actual value:
